# Sunday will be the main day for this competition, Saturday will only feature PBQ Events

Saturday: Senate Chamber (2nd Floor)
Sunday: Cartoon Room (3rd Floor)

This competition will be fairly tight on spacing, so **we will be limiting the number of guests per competitor to a maximum of two (2).**
There will be other options for seating throughout the Ohio Union if there is not enough space in the competition room.
